overview_description.description:
Subsets uses AI to automate lifecycle growth experiments in subscription businesses. We help increase retention and lifetime value by enabling commercial teams to create AI-driven experiments and automations, without engineering support.

It was founded in 2022 and is located in Copenhagen, Denmark.

about_short_description.short_description: Subsets is an artificial intelligence company that offers an AI-driven lifecycle growth platform for B2C subscription businesses.

product.name: AI-Driven Retention Experimentation Platform
product.description: A platform that enables subscription businesses to run AI-based retention experiments and measure their impact on subscriber lifetime value, renewal rates, and engagement.

product.name: Explainable AI Audience Generation
product.description: An AI feature that automatically identifies at-risk subscriber groups and explains behavioral signals driving churn.

product.name: Automated Reporting and Analytics
product.description: A system that tracks and reports the impact of retention experiments on key metrics like lifetime value, renewal rates, and user engagement.

product.name: Experimental Infrastructure for A/B Testing
product.description: Infrastructure enabling advanced A/B testing on dynamic subscriber cohorts with statistical significance.

product.description: Capability to activate AI predictions and audience segments directly within customer relationship management and email service provider platforms.
